Then actually viewed R7-B06-M1 native, usage720 and thumbnail320 in that exact order in three separate calls using the same method. Only after all three poster views were displayed did I make the first transcription judgment and independently assign the seven scores. No crop, image edit, image generation, revisit, peer review or sub-agent was used. Manual coordinates are approximate visual observations. No runtime thread ID or runner provenance is claimed.
